hero.title: Oil rises as concerns over Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia eclipse supply recovery

latest.title: Robinhood adds bitcoin worth $25 million to its balance sheet
latest.description: Robinhood has added bitcoin worth $25 million to its balance sheet, senior vice president and general manager of crypto and international, told the Starting Block Wednesday.

latest.title: BitMine sets 5% Ether supply ‘hard cap’ as accumulation target nears
latest.description: Tom Lee said BitMine will not accumulate Ether past 5% of the supply, turning the company’s target into a ceiling.

latest.title: Chevron CEO warns against 'unwise' diesel export ban, saying it could make things worse
latest.description: His comments come as rising Middle East crude exports and an emergency G7 stockpile release appear to have helped to ease supply fears.

latest.title: Treasury yields rise ahead of closely-watched 10-year auction and FOMC minutes
latest.description: U.S. Treasury yields climbed early Wednesday after retreating in the previous session, as investors awaited a closely watched 10-year note auction.

latest.title: Russia clears first crypto exchanges, custodians under new law
latest.description: Russia registered its first crypto exchanges and custodians, including its largest bank, Sberbank, which plans to launch crypto products on Dec. 1.

latest.title: Jaguar unveils $130,500 electric vehicle two years after controversial rebrand
latest.description: The launch comes as luxury rivals Ferrari and Bentley also push into EVs, seeking to test wealthy buyer's appetite for going electric.

latest.title: Down but not out. Bitcoin's stair-step bullish trajectory is still intact
latest.description: Bitcoin dipped to around $84,200 on Wednesday but stayed inside its recent range, keeping the broader bullish stair-step trajectory intact.

latest.title: DOJ invokes Bitcoin Fog ruling in potential blow to Roman Storm acquittal bid
latest.description: Prosecutors say a recent Bitcoin Fog appeals court ruling supports their argument that Tornado Cash activity in Manhattan was enough to establish venue for parts of Roman Storm’s case in New York.

latest.title: Why AI is both the hope and the hazard for world leaders, according to IMF chief Georgieva
latest.description: Kristalina Georgieva warns that the technology lifting growth hopes is also pushing up inflation and yields, just as public debt levels rose.

latest.title: Singapore's Temasek warns of the ‘biggest risk’ facing markets right now

latest.description: HSBC and Goldman Sachs expect the RBI to raise interest rates in December as well.

latest.title: Luxury developers flocked to the 'Hamptons of Hungary' — but some projects are stalling
latest.description: Lake Balaton in south-west Hungary has been a popular vacation destination for decades, but average transaction prices are falling.

latest.title: Kalshi’s 15-min gold markets overtake Ether just weeks after launch
latest.description: Gold recorded 542 million contracts and an estimated $5 million in fees in September, surpassing Ether’s 318 million contracts and $2.6 million, though Bitcoin remained far ahead.

latest.title: Pudgy Penguins’ Abstract becomes second Ethereum layer 2 to shut in a week
latest.description: The consumer-focused blockchain will close Dec. 15 after Igloo spent tens of millions supporting it, days after Blast said its own network was no longer worth operating.

latest.title: Trump set to talk to Russia's Putin 'very soon' about plague-related death in Siberia
